item.title: Vroom Boom Devlog: Rockets, Mines and Big Jumps
item.description: Vroom Boom is arcade car combat coming to Steam in 2027, and the game is still in development. The idea is simple and loud: fight with rockets and mines, take big jumps, and keep moving.
